entries.title: override_actor_radius_if_required on an object too small for the search
entries.cause: override_actor_radius_if_required moves an object that does not fit where it was placed, and the object is too small for the game's search for a free tile.

docTerms.note: On an object too small for the game's search for a free tile, such as a sheep, the game crashes when the object has to move.

entries.title: A line in a connection block has no terrain
entries.cause: Inside the braces of a connection command the game reads a terrain from every line, and {word} has none.
entries.fix: Move the line out of the connection block, before the connection commands.

docTerms.note: Inside the braces of a connection command the game crashes on this line. Write it once before the connection commands, outside braces.

entries.title: A connection reaches a land outside the map
entries.cause: A connection starts or ends at a land whose position lies outside the map at this map size.
entries.fix: Keep land_position inside the map for every map size.

entries.title: A defined name runs as cliff_type in <CLIFF_GENERATION>
entries.cause: {word} is a defined name where a command can stand, so the game runs it as {command} with no value.
entries.fix: Remove the defined name, or write the command it was meant to be.

docTerms.note: The game crashes when a defined name stands where a command can and the game runs it as this command with no value.

entries.title: Grouped player placement around a circle of length zero
entries.cause: Players are placed in team groups around a circle of length zero, so the game divides by zero.

entries.title: add_object without an object in a named group
entries.cause: add_object has no object while a group is named, so the game crashes when that entry is chosen.

entries.title: An object is placed on a land outside the map
entries.cause: An object is placed per land on a land whose position lies outside the map at this map size.
entries.fix: Keep land_position inside the map for every map size.

docTerms.note: The game crashes when a connection or an object placed per land reaches a land whose position lies outside the map, as a large position can on a small map.

entries.title: override_map_size makes the map smaller after the player lands
entries.cause: override_map_size makes the map smaller after the player lands were made, so a player can start outside the map.

docTerms.note: When this makes the map smaller after create_player_lands, a player can start outside the map and the game crashes with some seeds. Write it before the player lands.

entries.title: The map paints a terrain without movement data
entries.cause: The map paints terrain {terrain}, which the game's movement data does not cover, so the game crashes during the match.
entries.fix: Use a terrain that the game's movement data covers.
